name: Nettle Tumbletoe

poster.hook: For questions regarding Lot Thirteen. Nimble, charming, and very bad at being questioned.

story.appearance: Knee-high to a dinner guest, freckled, with copper curls pinned under a feathered mask that was definitely somebody else's. Their harlequin coat has seventeen pockets and a rapier worn like a conductor's baton.
story.concept: Nettle is a gentleman-thief in the oldest, most flirtatious sense: they steal things that were going to be stolen anyway, politely, and sign the receipt. Lady Ysolde Marchbanks has paid 200 gp upfront and 1,000 more on delivery to take Lot Thirteen before the hammer falls. Nettle also got an invitation from Pell, which they find far more worrying than the job.
story.stake: Lady Marchbanks holds the note on the Tumbletoe burrow-hold and will call it in if Nettle fails or talks. The 1,000 gp clears it.
story.goal: Deliver Lot Thirteen to Marchbanks without anyone getting hurt, least of all the family burrow.
story.secret: Marchbanks's dossier on tonight's guests names Odalys as Pell's forger. Marchbanks wants Lot Thirteen destroyed because it holds the ledger of her own purchases (fakes she overpaid for), and plans to expose the forger at midnight to cover her tracks. Nettle has told no one and has been very kind to Odalys ever since.
story.voice: Breezy, flattering and always halfway to the door. Calls people by the wrong names on purpose, to make them smile and correct you.
mannerisms: Pockets one small souvenir from every room, then returns it before leaving (usually)
Counts the exits aloud like a nursery rhyme
Tips their mask to anyone they have just robbed
story.trinket: A cut-glass button from Lady Marchbanks's coat

ties.text: Juggled in Tobias's troupe, the Merry Perils. He has paid their bail twice and Nettle repays him in stolen cheese. They would do anything for him except ask forgiveness.
ties.public: Old troupe-mates; Nettle still owes him bail money

ties.text: Knows from the dossier that Odalys is the forger. Says nothing and keeps being very, very kind to her.
ties.public: Keeps being unusually kind to her

ties.text: Dagny caught them casing the east wall a week ago and let them go with a warning. They respect each other the way two cats do.
ties.public: Met at the east wall; both remember it

story.intro: "Nettle Tumbletoe, entertainer. No, don't look in my pockets. Look at this pocket. Now look at that wall."

features.name: Lucky
features.text: When you roll a natural 1 on an attack, ability check or save, reroll it and use the new result.

features.name: Brave
features.text: Advantage on saves against being frightened.

features.name: Halfling Nimbleness
features.text: You can move through the space of any creature larger than you.

features.name: Naturally Stealthy
features.text: You can try to hide behind a creature at least one size larger than you.

features.name: Expertise
features.text: Double proficiency on Stealth and Sleight of Hand.

features.name: Sneak Attack (2d6)
features.text: Once per turn, deal an extra 2d6 damage with a finesse or ranged weapon if you have advantage, or an ally is within 5 ft of the target and you don't have disadvantage.

features.name: Thieves' Cant
features.text: A secret mix of jargon and signs that carries hidden messages.

features.name: Cunning Action
features.text: Bonus action: Dash, Disengage or Hide.

features.name: Fancy Footwork
features.text: If you make a melee attack against a creature on your turn, it can't make opportunity attacks against you for the rest of that turn.

features.name: Rakish Audacity
features.text: Add your Charisma modifier (+2) to initiative. You can Sneak Attack a target without advantage if you are within 5 ft of it and no other creature is within 5 ft of you.

features.name: Criminal Contact
features.text: You have a reliable contact who passes along messages from the underworld.

equipment.name: Ammunition
equipment.note: Bolts or arrows to match the ranged weapon

choices.label: Glass button
choices.value: A cut-glass button from Lady Marchbanks's coat

choices.label: The burrow note
choices.value: The mortgage note on the Tumbletoe burrow-hold, with Marchbanks's seal

choices.label: Heron lockpick
choices.value: A silver lockpick shaped like a heron, stolen with permission

flashback: What does the receipt you leave in place of every stolen thing actually say?

ifUnclaimed.npc: Nettle is absent. Lady Marchbanks has hired a jittery halfling named Fennick instead, who is found snagged on the gallery chandelier in Act 3. Marchbanks herself is the active rival bidder and pressures the party directly.

reassign.beat: Marchbanks's job: take Lot Thirteen before the hammer (200 gp up front, 1,000 on delivery)
reassign.text: Lady Marchbanks cornered you at the cloakroom: 200 gp now and 1,000 more if Lot Thirteen never goes under the hammer. She took you for her thief. You have not said no.

reassign.beat: The dossier naming Odalys the forger, and the midnight exposure (letter: the-ladys-midnight)
reassign.text: Marchbanks showed you her dossier. It names Corvin's apprentice as the forger of his relics, and she means to say so aloud at midnight. She does not know about the rest.

cuts: Nettle's lock-and-roof heist set pieces; hand the locks to Odalys's illusions or Dagny's keys.

keepsake.name: A harlequin's half-mask
keepsake.note: Nimble, charming, and still not answering questions.
